cohort: 58 infants with RSV-positive bronchiolitis and 17 healthy infants (aged < 18 months).
finding: This study identified signatures of RSV-associated bronchiolitis, including dominance of Haemophilus and a high concentration of BAFF/TNFSF13B, IL-8 and sTNF.R1 in nasal samples, and a high fecal concentration of BAFF/TNFSF13B.
